t: Free work-in-progress lessons for building and running SO-101 robot arms in a club.
steps: Find the Steam Clown LeRobot lessons page and read the introduction.
Contact the author before use. He asks teachers to do so.
Source or print the SO-101 parts.
Ask IT to prepare Ubuntu 24.04 or Windows with Miniconda.
Follow the Linux or Windows install lab to set up LeRobot.
Build the leader arm and the follower arm.
Calibrate and run the teleoperation check.
